subproblem.title: Every ball centred on spt V meets reg V
subproblem.statement: Assume AllardRegularityTheorem (Simon 5.2, the sibling node). Let n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, V = v(M, θ) a rectifiable n-varifold in U with generalized mean curvature H, H locally in Lᵖ(μ_V) with p > n, and θ a positive integer μ_V-a.e. on spt V. Then for every ξ ∈ spt V and every r > 0 the open ball B̆_r(ξ) contains a point of reg V.
subproblem.lean_statement: AllardRegularityTheorem → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 1 ≤ n → ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)), IsOpen U → ∀ (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ V.support → ∃ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ V.mult x = k) → ∀ ξ ∈ V.support, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → (V.regularSet ∩ ball ξ r).Nonempty
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: steps 1 and 4-7 of the parent proof (the density half of Corollary 7.3, printed proof p. 129: normalize by the least integer density N in a ball and apply 7.1 at a point of density 1). Hypothesis: the sibling statement AllardRegularityTheorem (Simon 5.2), taken as an explicit premise and passed on to child density_one_regular_point; the parent discharges it with Submission.allard_regularity_theorem. Setting: n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} open, V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U with generalized mean curvature H, V.LocallyLp H p, p > n, and (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ spt V → ∃ k ∈ ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ θ(x) = k), where M := V.carrier, θ := V.mult, μ := V.weight, spt V := V.support = U ∩ spt μ; ξ ∈ spt V and r > 0. Goal: (V.regularSet ∩ B̆_r(ξ)).Nonempty.
Dependencies: children c1_submanifold_open_inter, localized_varifold, density_one_regular_point, ae_approx_tangent_exists, density_of_approx_tangent, least_integer_density_point.
1. (F2) μ(ℝ^{n+ℓ} minus U) = 0, because μ ≪ Hⁿ⌞M (withDensity_absolutelyContinuous) and (Hⁿ⌞M)(ℝ^{n+ℓ} minus U) = Hⁿ((ℝ^{n+ℓ} minus U) ∩ M) = Hⁿ(∅) = 0 as M ⊆ U (restrict_apply₀', M null-measurable). Also μ(ℝ^{n+ℓ} minus spt μ) = 0 (Measure.support_mem_ae; ℝ^{n+ℓ} is second countable, hence hereditarily Lindelöf). So μ-a.e. x lies in U ∩ spt μ = spt V.
2. Combining step 1 with the hypothesis: (I) ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ k ∈ ℕ, 1 ≤ k ∧ θ(x) = k; in particular θ ≥ 1 μ-a.e.
3. (F1) By child ae_approx_tangent_exists (n ≥ 1, U open, θ ≥ 1 μ-a.e.), μ-a.e. x admits P with Chapter03.HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P; by step 1, μ-a.e. x lies in U; for such x, child density_of_approx_tangent gives V.HasDensity x θ(x). Hence ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, V.HasDensity x (V.mult x).
4. As U is open and ξ ∈ U, pick r₀ > 0 with B̆_{r₀}(ξ) ⊆ U; put r' := min(r, r₀) > 0 and B := B̆_{r'}(ξ), an open set with B ⊆ U and B ⊆ B̆_r(ξ).
5. Child least_integer_density_point, applied with (F1), (I), ξ ∈ spt V and r', gives N ∈ ℕ with N ≥ 1 and x₀ ∈ B such that V.HasDensity x₀ N and ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ B → N ≤ θ(x).
6. Child localized_varifold with B (open, B ⊆ U) and c := 1/N > 0 gives W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ B with W.mult x = θ(x)/N, W.weight = ofReal(1/N) • μ⌞B, W.support = B ∩ spt V, W.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H and W.LocallyLp H p.
7. W.mult ≥ 1 W.weight-a.e.: by Measure.ae_smul_measure it suffices to have it μ⌞B-a.e.; by ae_restrict_iff' (B measurable) this means: for μ-a.e. x, x ∈ B → 1 ≤ θ(x)/N, which follows from step 5 since N > 0.
8. W.HasDensity x₀ 1: let d := r' - dist(x₀, ξ) > 0. For 0 < s < d the closed ball B_s(x₀) lies in B, so W.weight(B_s(x₀)) = ofReal(1/N)·μ(B_s(x₀) ∩ B) = ofReal(1/N)·μ(B_s(x₀)) (Measure.restrict_apply for the closed ball). Hence for s ∈ (0, d) the density ratio of W at x₀ equals ofReal(1/N)·(μ(B_s(x₀))/ofReal(ω_n sⁿ)), which tends to ofReal(1/N)·ofReal(N) = ofReal(1) by V.HasDensity x₀ N and ENNReal.Tendsto.const_mul (ofReal N ≠ ∞).
9. Child density_one_regular_point (premise AllardRegularityTheorem) applied to W on the open set B, with H, p, steps 6-8 and x₀ ∈ B, gives x₀ ∈ W.regularSet: x₀ ∈ W.support = B ∩ spt V and IsC1Submanifold n (B̆_ρ(x₀) ∩ (B ∩ spt V)) for some ρ > 0.
10. Let ρ' := min(ρ, d) > 0. Then B̆_{ρ'}(x₀) ⊆ B̆_ρ(x₀) and B̆_{ρ'}(x₀) ⊆ B (triangle inequality), so B̆_{ρ'}(x₀) ∩ spt V = B̆_{ρ'}(x₀) ∩ (B̆_ρ(x₀) ∩ (B ∩ spt V)), which is IsC1Submanifold n by child c1_submanifold_open_inter. Since x₀ ∈ spt V, x₀ ∈ V.regularSet, and x₀ ∈ B ⊆ B̆_r(ξ). Hence V.regularSet ∩ B̆_r(ξ) is nonempty.
proof_key_steps: μ-a.e. point lies in spt V, so θ is a positive integer μ-a.e.
Θ(μ,x) = θ(x) μ-a.e. from the Ch. 3 tangent-space children
Shrink the ball into U; least integer density N and a point x₀ with Θ = N
Normalized varifold W = v(M ∩ B, θ/N) has θ/N ≥ 1 a.e. and density 1 at x₀
Density-one point is regular for W; shrink the radius to transfer regularity to V
